Federated learning playground

Run a federation. See every decision.

Four banks train one shared model without moving their customer records. Each short mission lets you change one part of that system and see what happens.

Click a numbered task in the navbar to open its mission.
The main figure

Four private books, one shared model

Each coloured branch has a different customer book and trains a local copy. Only model changes travel; the customer rows stay inside the branch.
